articles.title: DRDO develops advanced composite hull for next-gen infantry combat vehicle
articles.summary: DRDO has developed an advanced composite hull for India's next-generation infantry combat vehicle (ICV). This significant technological advancement aims to enhance the protection, agility, and overall combat effectiveness of future Indian Army ground forces. Such indigenous developments are crucial for bolstering national defence capabilities and reducing reliance on foreign technology in critical military hardware, aligning with 'Atmanirbhar Bharat' initiatives.
